dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: Raranana would appear when the adults aren't around, just like me slacking off farming work.

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: But Minoo always made fun of me all the time for believing in Raranana, and got mad at me for saying the name wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: I've seen Raranana with my own eyes, though... They're the weedfolk, so Raranana does exist for sure.
